events.text: {"verdict":"finish","decision":"Close out H006/H013 and move H008 into T-006, so T-275 stops sitting on hold. 1) Check that 1d66ef0 is on origin/main and that referrals.html still has T-058's Replies column and team total. 2) Run /usr/bin/python3 workshop-plan/ops/test_referrals.py and node app/scripts/probe-referrals.mjs --live. Both must pass. Check that the live mirror's referrals.html has no Date.UTC(2026,9,7), reads first_cohort and carries the 'Paid monthly...' line. Republish it if it doesn't. 3) Add one step to T-006's post-launch switch runbook: 'Set links.site in workshop-plan/ops/referrals.json to the production funnel domain, run referrals.py, probe-referrals.mjs --live, mark H008 fixed in AUDIT.md'. In AUDIT.md, set H008 to 'tracked in T-006'. 4) On T-275, change the links.site done-when item to 'moved to T-006 switch step'. Leaving T-275 on hold would keep finished work out of Adi's review.","outward_ok":["git commit and push of the T-006 runbook edit, AUDIT.md and any unpushed T-275 files (referrals.py, referrals.html, referrals.stats.json) to adisuja/3-day-tantra-ai-revops-workshop main","republish referrals.html and referrals.stats.json to adisuja/tantra-workshop-live (pull --rebase, copy, push) only if the live copy is stale"],"reassign_to_claude":true,"adi_input":null}
